title: Industrial wastewater identification based on HPLC combined with data standardization and ensemble learning algorithms
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16613-16621
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00080K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Siyao Li, Haiyan Qin, Xi Wu, Zhirong Suo
A novel method based on high-performance liquid chromatography combined with data standardization and ensemble learning algorithms is proposed, effectively achieving high-accuracy identification of industrial wastewater sources.
